summary: Your mind can move through symbol, mood, and possibility. Clarity may take effort because perception is not only literal.
body: Mercury opposition Neptune describes a porous connection between thought and imagination. You may be gifted with metaphor, music, image, spiritual language, or empathic listening, but you may also struggle with vagueness, avoidance, or hearing what you hope is true. Other people may project onto your words, or you may project onto theirs. The gift is imaginative intelligence. The growth is learning to ask simple clarifying questions before the story becomes too large to check.
gift: Imagination, empathy, symbolic thinking, and the ability to communicate subtle experience.
shadow: Confusion, mixed signals, avoidance, idealization, and believing a story before checking the facts.
integration: Use clear language as an ally to imagination. Specifics do not ruin the magic; they help the right meaning survive contact with real life.
do: Check whether you heard facts or feelings
Use art for what cannot be stated directly
dont: Let ambiguity make decisions for you
Promise what you have not understood
